HTML tag names are case-insensitive: an uppercase void element must not swallow the content that follows it

```rust title="Rust"
use html_to_markdown_rs::convert;
use html_to_markdown_rs::ConversionOptions;

fn main() {
    let html = r#"<html><head><META HTTP-EQUIV="Content-Type" CONTENT="text/html; charset=us-ascii"></head><body><p>Signature placeholder</p></body></html>"#;
    let options: ConversionOptions = Default::default();
    let result = convert(html, Some(options.clone())).expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.content);
}
```
